description: This file provides a client-side utility for fetching active user trend analytics data from a backend API. It includes a helper function to convert date inputs to ISO strings and an exported async function that constructs URL parameters, makes an API request, and processes the response data.

methods.name: toIsoOrUndefined(dateLike)
methods.description: Converts a date-like input to an ISO string if valid, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: fetchActiveUsersTrend({ startDate, endDate, from, to, granularity = 'day', tenant_id, status, } = {})
methods.description: Fetches active users trend data from the backend API, with support for date filtering, granularity, tenant id, and status.
